name: 8 Lire XL
notes: The SOMA Lyra-8 in full, after its manual (v2.1): two delay lines with cross-feedback, LFO / SELF, TRI / SQ and hiss, the distortion after it, FM / off / LFO per pair, FAST per pair, the 34>56 78>12 switch, PITCH and HOLD per group, TOTAL FB, VIBRATO, the Hyper LFO, touch (velocity and aftertouch open the envelopes), bleed. The rear jacks are inputs of the assembly, each with a "plugged" row. Switches are 0..1 rows (the source switch: FM 0, off 0.5, LFO 1).
